requirements.text: A minimum 2.5 cumulative grade point average (CGPA) is necessary.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The diploma must be completed within five years of program admission.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Teachers seeking a reclassification should note that, since integrated programs are looked upon as upgrading work, all courses must be completed no more than 10 years before the date of reclassification through the Teachers’ Qualification Service.

sections.note:
Graduate courses may be completed with prior approval.
Normally 15 units are completed from each of the French and education course lists below.
